$comment: Consolidated register of documentary contradictions. Each entry names the values in conflict, the registered source of each value and where it sits, and what would resolve it. A contradiction stays here, with status open, until it is resolved; a resolved entry keeps its values and states the resolution. Validated by scripts/validate_registers.py.

entries.subject: Fifteen corrections and conflicts from the 993 Turbo research audit of 2026-10-02 (compression ratio, boost, engine mass, oil capacity, fan data, ignition, studs, piston alloy, K16 temperature, A/R, piston spray jets, engine-mount bolt pitch, engine specifications document)
entries.resolution: Row-by-row status on 2026-11-05, against the digest-pinned audit files, which are not edited. Thirteen rows are closed in the audit itself: AUDIT-001, 002, 003, 005, 009, 011 and 012 by corrected source metadata; AUDIT-004 by withdrawing the Turbo attribution of 232 kg and 12 L (no registered source gives the M64/60 engine mass or oil capacity, so neither is counted anywhere); AUDIT-006, 008 and 015 by restricting Carrera data to the Carrera (fan ratio, cooling flow, fan masses and the Engine Specifications sheet are not Turbo facts); AUDIT-007 and 010 by qualified engine facts (single ignition, read in the level-A PET; the 2618 alloy and 468 g belong to the aftermarket MAHLE kit). AUDIT-014, engine-mount bolt pitch, is resolved as M12 x 1.5 x 125: the level-A SRC-PORSCHE-PET-993 (Kat 017 PDF, 248 pages, SHA-256 b67cf3586f9a92bee5ccc8e84462515231c84ddd23c610e4a2e739fedb1166aa, page 230, illustration 401-00, position 22) designates 900 082 118 09 'Hexagon-head bolt M 12 X 1,5 X 125'; the bulletin's own body text says M12 x 1.5 x 125 and its matching nut is M12 x 1.5, so the 'M12 x 1.2 x 125' of the bulletin parts table is read as a typographical error. The PET lists that number on the front-axle plate 401-00 only: it fixes the bolt's designation, not where the Turbo mount uses it. AUDIT-013, short piston spray-jet length, is explicitly deferred to CTR-0018.

entries.subject: Centre bore of the Fuchs wheels 37024, 37026, 37027 and 37028

values.location: technical data summary of the approval; the approvals 000086, 000087 and 000088 state the same 71.58 mm
application annex, Porsche 993 and 993 Turbo rows

values.value: CENTER_BORE = 71.5 mm labelled as the wheel bore
values.location: size parameter CENTER_BORE, attributed to the type approval; same value in comp-fuchs-37027.011.json and comp-fuchs-37028.011.json, while comp-fuchs-37024.013.json stores 71.58

entries.resolution: CENTER_BORE carries the wheel centre bore (Mittenlochdurchmesser) declared in each wheel's own type approval: 71.58 mm for 37024, 37026, 37027 and 37028. The 71.5 mm figure is the vehicle hub pattern and centring diameter in the application annex, not a wheel dimension; it is not stored as a wheel parameter. The four component records, their interface-proxy STEP files and tests/test_wheel_proxy.py were aligned on 2026-11-05, and COMP-FUCHS-37027.011 now cites its own approval 000087. Nominal documentary values without tolerances; no fit, spatial check or wheel release follows from this correction.
